Thanks again for the call this morning — appreciate you walking through HealthFirst's use case and compliance needs. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- SOC 2: you flagged that your procurement team requires SOC 2 Type II or a SOC 2 roadmap. Can you confirm whether a Type II is mandatory for the initial pilot or if Type I / SOC evidence will suffice?

- Vendor questionnaire: you asked about initiating the vendor security questionnaire — I can fill the attached questionnaire and return it by EOD Wednesday.
- Pen test report: you asked whether we can share our recent third-party penetration test report and details on our vulnerability management process (SLA, scanning cadence, disclosure). We'll need a signed NDA/redaction agreement for the full report; in the meantime I can share a redacted summary and our process doc.

Next steps:
1) I'll return the completed vendor questionnaire (attached) and a redacted pen test summary.
2) If you need the full report, please confirm your NDA process or send an NDA and I'll route to Legal.
3) We can schedule a short follow-up with our security engineering lead to review technical questions — are you available next Wed (7/1) or Thu (7/2)?

Thanks — I'll attach the questionnaire and a short process summary in my next email.

Thanks Marissa — great recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- SOC 2: For procurement we prefer a Type II but for the pilot we can accept SOC evidence and a roadmap to Type II, provided there's an ETA and interim compensating controls documented.
- HIPAA: Yes — PHI will be in scope for the pilot. Please include details about BAAs and how you isolate PHI in hosted vs private deployments.
- Vendor questionnaire: attached is our standard vendor security questionnaire (VQ). Could you fill and return the questionnaire? We have a short internal turnaround (5 business days) once the VQ is submitted.
- Pen test report: We need to review your recent third-party pen test findings and your remediation SLA. If full reports require an NDA, our legal team can sign an NDA; please advise the contact for that.

Also: what is your typical scanning cadence (internal and external scans) and severity SLA for critical/high findings?

Thanks,

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Julia Park <julia.park@healthfirst.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-26T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pen test report + vuln management process — follow-up and next steps

Julia — thanks, and appreciate the turnaround. Please find attached our completed Vendor Security Questionnaire (answered inline) and a redacted pen test summary. High-level answers to your questions below: 

- SOC 2: Redwood Inference completed SOC 2 Type II for the hosted control plane in March 2026. For Private deployments, customers can request SOC evidence and we provide deployment-specific controls documentation. ETA for next internal audit cycle (for any expanded scopes) is Q1 2027 — happy to provide the roadmap and compensating controls.

- HIPAA: We sign BAAs for customers handling PHI on our Private offering and for dedicated environments. We isolate PHI using network segmentation, customer-specific encryption keys, and access controls. I'll have our Legal contact reach out to yours for the BAA.

- Scanning cadence: External third-party external scans: monthly; internal authenticated scans: weekly on dedicated infra; SCA/Dependency scans: nightly for our build pipelines.

- Remediation SLA / vuln management: Critical (CVSS >=9.0) — mitigation or compensating control within 24 hours; High (7.0-8.9) — fix/mitigation within 7 calendar days or documented workaround; Medium (4.0-6.9) — planned within 30 days; Low — tracked in backlog. We also maintain a public timeline for major incidents and notify impacted customers per contract SLA.

- Disclosure & reports: We provide a redacted penetration test report summary for initial review. Full reports are shared under NDA; we can also provide an executive summary and a remediation tracker (attested by our security engineering lead).

Attachments: Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_v1.docx (completed), PenTest_Report_STUB.pdf (redacted summary)

Next steps:
- If you can confirm NDA contact, I'll route the full report to Legal.
- Would you like a 30-min technical review with our security engineering lead (Monica) next week?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
